commands.command: python -c "import json,pathlib,collections; p=pathlib.Path(r'kod/data/raw/legal-silver-2000/manifest.json'); x=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')); rec=x['records']; g=collections.defaultdict(list); [g[r['sha256']].append((r['doc_id'],r['split'],r['publisher'],r['year'])) for r in rec]; d=[(h,v) for h,v in g.items() if len(v)>1]; print('records',len(rec),'unique_text_sha',len(g),'duplicate_groups',len(d),'duplicate_records',sum(len(v) for _,v in d)); print('cross_split',[(h,v) for h,v in d if len({q[1] for q in v})>1])"

python -c "import json,pathlib,collections; p=pathlib.Path(r'kod/data/processed/legal-silver-2000/legal-silver-2000.jsonl'); rows=[json.loads(l) for l in p.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines() if l.strip()]; print('processed',len(rows)); print('split',dict(collections.Counter(r['split'] for r in rows))); print('years',min(r['source']['year'] for r in rows),max(r['source']['year'] for r in rows)); print('tokens',sum(len(r['tokens']) for r in rows)); print('mentions',sum(len(r['mentions']) for r in rows)); print('clusters',sum(len(r['clusters']) for r in rows)); print('zeros',sum(sum(1 for m in r['mentions'] if m.get('is_empty')) for r in rows))"
commands.result: processed=247; split=200/25/22; years=2005-2007; tokens=121270; mentions=38427; clusters=27560; zeros=0
